remarks:
Welcome to your own private corner of North Collins, NY! This charming 3-bedroom ranch offers 2 full baths and is nestled on a quiet dead-end street surrounded by beautiful country scenery. Filled with character and thoughtful design, the home’s unique layout seamlessly blends the main living areas with additional flexible space on the lower level, providing endless possibilities for a family room, home gym, office, or recreation area. The lower level also features a convenient laundry area and a full bath.

The home features a modern, high-efficiency wall-mounted combination boiler, providing energy-efficient heating and on-demand hot water without the need for a separate hot water tank. This updated system offers both comfort and efficiency year-round.

Step outside to your private backyard retreat, where you’ll find an oversized stamped concrete patio complete with a covered seating area and hot tub—perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. Amish-crafted storage sheds provide plenty of room for tools and equipment, while the expansive green space offers endless opportunities for outdoor activities, gardening, or simply enjoying the peaceful country setting.

Enjoy the tranquility of country living while still being conveniently located near local amenities. This North Collins gem is ready to welcome you home. Seller reserves right to set an offer deadline. Open House Sunday 8/30 11am-1pm
